comment: The random run's operations (weight: default share of run TIME; cost: rough seconds on one host; a proposal's chance is weight/cost) and the documented refusals: those its negative operations probe, and those it does not propose (proposed false, with why). verified_at: the product commit each cite was re-read at.

operations.note: a delete waits out the lease horizon
proposed only as a negative: a repair step, not part of the procedure (docs/standalone-deployment.md:696)

limits.name: delete a source whose snapshot has a restore target
limits.side_effect: refused for a snapshot dependent after its reservation committed: the source is reserved and never serves again

limits.name: delete a snapshot that has a restore target
an eleventh snapshot
limits.note: no operator page states the limit: it is the design invariant INV-SNAPK-HEAD-BOUND-001; what the product answers to an eleventh is a product result

limits.name: restore from a snapshot of a restore target
limits.side_effect: the target name stays bound and is never created

limits.name: attach on the old host after a move
limits.why: blockvolume exits 78 (reason=moved) and the typed attach does not read the reason: it answers unknown, which takes the volume out of the run

limits.name: attach a deleted volume
limits.why: blockvolume exits 78 (reason=deleted) and the typed attach does not read the reason: it answers unknown

limits.name: attach on a stale local root
limits.why: blockvolume exits 78 (reason=superseded) and the typed attach does not read the reason: it answers unknown; the shadow also never attaches where an earlier root lies (docs/volume-lifecycle.md:190-192)

limits.name: attach with other geometry
limits.why: blockvolume exits 78 (geometry_mismatch) and the typed attach does not read the reason: it answers unknown

limits.name: attach after a stop
limits.why: a sealed HEAD stays sealed for its own epoch: no grant comes and the attach times out, answered unknown

limits.name: restore into a deleted name
limits.why: the restore's not_admitted here cannot be told from a request that persisted: answered unknown
